In this video, we explore the official Steam OS running on the all-new ASUS TUF A14. It’s powered by the AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 392 and backed by the most powerful iGPU on the market right now, the Radeon 8060S. I’ve set up this laptop in a dual boot configuration, with Windows 11 and Steam OS installed on separate SSDs. We’ve transformed this laptop into a powerful Steam Deck, but we’re calling it the Steam Book!
